paras: In Brill, Austil de Mon trains Forsaken warriors at Gallows' End Tavern. He teaches the newly risen to fight in service of the Dark Lady.

Austil de Mon trains Forsaken warriors inside Gallows' End Tavern in Brill. Warriors leaving Deathknell come to him among their first instructors. The living once drank and rested in the inn. Now Austil teaches newly liberated undead to master martial discipline and combat against the foes surrounding the kingdom.
